# What bubbletea renders for a recursive component -- which survives as a
# render method, since nothing can splice a cycle -- read off the snapshot of
# the running program.
#
# Three defects, each visible only in the rendered text:
#
# - A snapshot rendered the Model the test began with. The Model is a value,
#   and the one registered for the snapshot and the test's own local were two
#   copies of it, so `c.deeper.click()` changed a copy nobody drew: `level 3`
#   never appeared.
# - Children handed to a render method were read for nodes only, so the slot
#   insertion `frame` forwards down its own recursion rendered nothing, and
#   ALPHA appeared once where each of the three levels shows it.
# - A branch not taken still joined its empty string into the box, which is a
#   blank line below the innermost level.


env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=bubbletea app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep '(?s)top *\nlevel 3 *\nlevel 2 *\nlevel 1 *\n> deeper' app.sngl.snapshots/deeper.ansi
grep -count=3 'ALPHA' app.sngl.snapshots/forwarded.ansi

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component frame(n int, content ...component node) node {
    vbox {
        content
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                text(value="level {n}")
            }
        }
    }
}

component forward(n int, content ...component node) node {
    vbox {
        content
        if n > 0 {
            forward(n=n - 1) {
                content
            }
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var depth = 2

    vbox {
        frame(n=depth) {
            text(value="top")
        }
        button #deeper(text="deeper", @click { depth += 1 })
    }
}

component forwarded node {
    var depth = 2

    vbox {
        forward(n=depth) {
            text(value="ALPHA")
        }
    }
}

func testDeeper(t Test, c main) {
    c.deeper.click()
    t.snapshot("deeper")
}

func testForwarded(t Test, c forwarded) {
    t.snapshot("forwarded")
}

window {
    main
}
